programmes.d: Mark helps longtime friends cope when their adopted daughter wants to find her natural parents.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: As Difficult as ABC
programmes.d: Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.
Jonathan and Mark connect a young blind woman with a disfigured artist.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Child of God

Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty is on hand to provide legal assistance.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Match Made in Heaven

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Brightest Star
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.
Jonathan and Mark help a bullied orphan whose grandfather may lose him to a heartless social worker.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Investment In Caring
programmes.d: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Right Thing
programmes.d: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.
Mark switches places with an attractive movie star who has a low opinion of men.

Jonathan helps reunite his lonely widow (Dorothy McGuire) and their estranged daughter.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 1

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 2

Mark asks Jonathan to help erase everything bad that's happened to him recently.

Tragedy occurs when a Neo-Nazi disputes the Holocaust with the son of a death camp survivor.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Devil and Jonathan Smith
